description: In a weak combination of samurai movie and Bomber Bikers of Shonan, Tokyo street-punk Masao buys a treas-ured FZR "katana" motorcycle and becomes a knight of the road, attacking criminals with a genuine katana sword. Based on the manga by Shinichi Sugimura in Young Magazine.
